title: Fail closed on missing graph linkage before work starts
narrative: Fangore composes a plan that still names a step the host has not wired, and another repeating step without a stop rule. The library must refuse those plans before any runner work starts, naming the missing edge so operators can fix wiring instead of debugging a mid-run crash. Complements `fangore_graph_executor` (authorized run once linkage is sound) and `fangore_convergence_ceiling` (budgets once a loop is allowed). See the inspiration requirements for linkage versus dependency injection and stop contracts[^insp-linkage].
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `runner_stop_and_ok.yaml`: hard ok flags and exact edge codes.
